note: Presentation that leaves active input because the build does not offer what it draws. Nothing here is skipped or excluded: each row names the case it came from, where that source still is, the boundary that holds its generic obligation today, and what has to exist before it comes back. This file is data a reader opens; no test imports or executes it.
